announcements.headline: Firebird Demonstrates Proprietary LMR Cathode Performance
summary: Firebird's proprietary Lithium Manganese-Rich (LMR) cathode demonstration is a critical de-risking milestone, validating the company's vertically integrated strategy from its Oakover manganese project through to battery-grade cathode material — a key differentiator in the battery materials supply chain narrative.

Near-term catalysts to watch include independent third-party validation of performance data, potential offtake or JV discussions with battery manufacturers, and whether this demonstration accelerates the Oakover DFS timeline — any of these would materially re-rate the stock from its current exploration-stage valuation.

With access infrastructure now approved, Elementos can progress site works and construction planning, bringing the project closer to a Final Investment Decision — the next major catalyst investors should monitor, alongside any updates to project financing discussions or strategic partnership activity.
